registered: 2026-09-23, before any result of the single-block equivalent exists
purpose: case study of the revised paper: the full plant model F against the single-block equivalent that grid studies use, one supply block for the whole plant driven by the total server power
model: K01_1f243e: s1_single.single_spec. One block rated at the sum of the 48 ratings, parameters by s1_spec.group_params with the gain rule 'gains'; T1 and T2, the 12 feeders and the 48 unit transformers each merged into one equal-loss element weighted by the initial active flows of F, feeder charging summed, one MV bus; cooling summed into one constant-power load at the equivalent hall bus, the two auxiliary loads into one constant-impedance load at the MV bus, the remainder at bus 8 unchanged. Its source checksum is recorded in p5_manifest.json
reference: F: the small-signal results of P2 and the production and strict time-domain runs of P3, read as they are
small_signal: the P2 definitions without change: 601-point grid from 0.1 to 20 Hz; band error per task and output, RMS of the complex difference over 0.1 to 3 Hz and over above 3 to 20 Hz divided by the RMS of the response of F; refined peak gain and frequency; phase difference at the grid frequency of the largest gain of F; modes by s1_summarize.modes; for the figure, the oscillatory modes between 3 and 20 Hz whose contribution reaches 10 percent of the largest contribution of F over the tasks
time_domain: the P3 definitions without change: Rodas, KLU, --tol paper (rtol 1e-4, atol 1e-6, hmax 0.01 s, output every 0.0025 s, tol_ic 1e-6); errors over 1 s to 61 s on deviations from each model's own initial value; s1_paper_p3.td_errors, error_spectrum and screen_of
strict: S2_phase_build: K = 1 at --tol main (rtol 1e-8, atol 1e-10), paired with the strict run of F of the same input
rerun_rule: a reported time-domain difference below 0.1 percent is rerun at rtol 1e-6, as in P3

internal.per_hall: first block of every hall of F, the one block of K = 1: DC-link voltage, AFE and VSI current magnitudes, AFE and VSI modulation indices, AC input power, VSI AC-bus voltage magnitude, PSU voltage, DC-DC voltage, server power
internal.buses: voltage magnitudes of the PCC, of every MV bus and of every hall bus

gates.determinism: the internal run of each model reproduces its production run: PCC active power to 1e-09 MW, DC-link voltage to 1e-12 p.u.
gates.hall_spread: the four blocks of a hall of F agree to 1e-10 in every recorded variable

gates.per_input: equations equal variables; initial residual below 1e-10; server power of K = 1 equal to that of F and of the scenario to 1e-9 MW; every hall maps to the one block; static loads equal to those of F; a 2 s run without input stays at the equilibrium; the offset of the bus demand from 315 MW is reported, since the conversion losses of the equivalent differ
gates.positive_control: nominal design in every hall, 6 MW per hall: K = 1 against F, normalized difference of the PCC responses below 1e-9 on every 12th point of the grid, every eigenvalue of K = 1 among those of F

never: no rule, input, window, tolerance or error definition is changed after a result of the single-block equivalent has been seen; no failure is hidden by a change of parameters
